quotes.name: Brenda Okoro
quotes.quote: Renewal means West Oakland businesses and residents, 23 days on the clock, and a closeout record on the table before council votes.

quotes.name: Marcus Webb
quotes.quote: The closeout is published, the ordinance is on the calendar with the scope that works and the 23-day clock still running — the hearing record carries the proof, and the roll call belongs to the Council.
